Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta
Italian commandant (1417–1468)Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta was an Italian condottiero and nobleman, a member of the House of Malatesta and lord of Rimini and Fano from 1432. He was widely considered by his contemporaries as one of the most daring military leaders in Italy and commanded the Venetian forces in the 1465 campaign against the Ottoman Empire. He was also a poet and patron of the arts.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta
Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta (19 June 1417 – 7 October 1468) was an Italian 
condottiero and nobleman, a member of the 
House of Malatesta and lord of 
Rimini and 
Fano from 1432. He was widely considered by his contemporaries as one of the most daring military leaders in Italy and commanded the 
Venetian forces in the 1465 campaign against the 
Ottoman Empire. He was also a 
poet and patron of the arts.
